title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 35: the desert blossoming like a rose, the blind seeing, and the ransomed returning to Zion with singing.

questions.text: Like what will the desert rejoice and blossom?
questions.explanation: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad, and the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

questions.text: Whose glory will be given to the blossoming desert?
questions.explanation: Lebanon's glory will be given to it, with the excellence of Carmel and Sharon, and they will see Yahweh's glory.

questions.text: What are the hearers told to do with the weak hands and feeble knees?
questions.explanation: The command is to strengthen the weak hands and make the feeble knees firm.

answers.text: Strengthen the hands and make the knees firm
Anoint them with soothing oil and wine
Bind them up tightly with strong cords
Wash them clean in the springs of water

questions.text: What message is to be told to those who have a fearful heart?
questions.explanation: They are told, "Be strong! Don't be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance... He will come and save you."

answers.text: "Flee quickly to the strong city for refuge"
"Wait in silence until the indignation is past"
"Be strong! Don't be afraid! Your God will come and save you"
"Weep no more, for the long night is over at last"

questions.text: What will happen to the eyes of the blind and the ears of the deaf?
questions.explanation: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

answers.text: They will be judged for their unbelief
The eyes will be opened and the ears unstopped
They will stay closed until Zion is rebuilt
They will be covered with a veil

questions.text: Like what will the lame man leap?
questions.explanation: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing.

answers.text: Like a goat on the mountains

questions.text: What will the burning sand become?
questions.explanation: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water.

questions.text: What will the highway there be called?
questions.explanation: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called "The Holy Way"; the unclean shall not pass over it.

questions.text: Who will walk on that road where no lion will be?
questions.explanation: No lion or ravenous animal will be there, but the redeemed will walk there.

questions.text: What will be on the heads of Yahweh's ransomed ones when they come with singing to Zion?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's ransomed ones will return and come with singing to Zion, and everlasting joy will be on their heads.
